exposure: risk factors for developmental dysplasia of the hips
outcome: false negative Ortolani and Barlow examination
cohort: Newborn infants born in a single institution between 1999 and 2013, who underwent universal clinical screening for DDH and, if risk factors were present, a bilateral hip ultrasound.
finding: Breech position was the only statistically significant risk factor for a false negative Ortolani/Barlow examination in neonatal screening for DDH.
